name: Brand Name
audience: who the product is for, e.g. "Women only: whoever wears the product is a woman"
palette: background colors, accent color with hex for headlines and pills, body text color
font_style: headline and body font description, e.g. bold geometric sans-serif headlines
prompt_rules: The product MUST be the exact product in the attached reference photo, unchanged: <list every distinctive detail: shape, materials, colors, logo placement, hardware>. Keep its proportions and every detail; only change angle, lighting and setting. Do not invent a different product or logo.
Render every word of on-image text exactly as written in quotes, spelled correctly, and no other text.
High-end e-commerce photography quality, sharp focus, natural soft shadows, no watermarks, no extra logos.
claims_to_avoid: claims legal/ops can't stand behind (guarantees, shipping speed, medical or endorsement claims)

persona_slug.name: Who they are, in a few words
persona_slug.source: the data this persona comes from (survey share, winning ads, reviews, forums)

language_rules.es: All on-image text is in Spanish exactly as written in quotes, as a Spanish-speaking person living in the USA would say it (neutral US Latino, Mexican-leaning, using 'tú'). Keep every accent and sign: á é í ó ú ñ ¿ ¡. Numbers in US format. Do not translate brand names.

program.schedule: e.g. Tue + Fri 5:50am America/New_York (routine name + trigger id once created)
program.roas_note: any period where ROAS is unreliable

drive_folder_id: id of the brand's '<Brand> – Weekly Static Ads' Drive folder

slack.notify_channel_id: Slack user or channel id to DM when a batch is ready

format_guides.fb_comment: Render the testimonial as a real Facebook mobile comment thread, pixel-faithful to the current Facebook app: light grey rounded comment bubble on white, small round profile photo on the left (realistic person matching the persona), commenter name in bold dark text (first name + last initial), comment text in Facebook's system sans font at normal comment size, a grey row under the bubble reading like "2d   Like   Reply", and a small overlapping reaction pill (like/love icons + a count) at the bubble's lower right. Optionally 2–3 stacked comments with replies indented. Plain, native, not designed; no Facebook logo.
format_guides.trustpilot: Render the testimonial as a real Trustpilot review card, faithful to Trustpilot's current design: white card with thin light-grey border, reviewer row with a small round initials avatar, reviewer first name + last initial and country code, a row of five green square star tiles with white stars (Trustpilot green #00B67A), a short bold review title, the review text in a clean sans font, and a small grey date. Show individual review cards only: no Trustpilot logo, no TrustScore, no overall rating or review count, no 'Verified' badge.
format_guides.x_post: Render as a real X (formerly Twitter) post screenshot, faithful to the current X app in light mode: white background, round profile photo top-left, display name in bold black, then grey @handle and "· 3h", the post text in X's Chirp-like sans at native size (black, left-aligned, no quotation marks), optionally an attached photo with rounded corners, then a grey engagement row with the reply, repost, like and view icons and small counts, all in X's thin grey icon style. No blue verification checkmark, no X logo, no 'Twitter' bird. It must read as a genuine X post, not a designed graphic.
